{{otheruses redirect|Minstrel|the item prefix|Minstrel's|the music-themed [[mesmer]] [[elite specialization]]|Troubadour}} {{Weapon infobox | uslot = Superior Sigil of Energy | type = Focus | level = 80 | salvage = none | bound = account use | skin = The Minstrel (skin); The Bard (skin); Song of the Numberless Pack (skin); The Bard Experiment (skin) | rarity = Legendary | prefix = selectable | id = 30688 | gallery2 = The Minstrel wielded.jpg | gallery2-text = Wielded. | gallery3 = The Minstrel footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Musical, purple splotchy footfalls. }} [[The Minstrel]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] focus crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|The Minstrel is a bard's dearest companion, a vessel of their spirit and artistry. Delicate notes fade in the wielder's wake, leaving passersby with a gentle whisper of their vestige.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 The Bard | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of The Minstrel | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[The Minstrel]] is a golden rooster harp. While stowed, faint music notes float away from the focus. While drawn, a purple aura appears and large musical notes float away from the focus. ;Aura * White swirls can be seen around the user's arm * A trail of musical notes emits from the weapon ;Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, a harp strumming sound is heard * Musical swirls erupts around the user ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind a small paint like splotches and bursts of faint purple, pink and white musical notes. === Gallery === File:Minstrel aura effect.jpg|Drawn effect. Minstrel]] novelty. == Trivia == * Additional effects were added to The Minstrel on the [[Game updates/2016-09-20|20th September 2016 update]]. * With the [[Game updates/2018-07-24|24th July 2018 update]], players who have unlocked [[The Minstrel (skin)|the Minstrel's skin]] are able to purchase the [[Musical Minstrel]] novelty from [[Sarettokk]]. * The Minstrel was a joke profession announced on the Guild Wars 2 main site, before shattering into a picture of the truly announced [[Mesmer]]. * Inside the breast of The Minstrel is a [[:File:The Minstrel feather.jpg|feather]]. == See also == *
